mip_knapsack.current_generator_gap: Implemented nonzero_density, selected_fraction and independent/weighted/correlated profit modes with observed feature checks. Weighted-sum planted instances carry independently checked dual certificates. Independent-profit instances do not inherit those optimum claims.

cvrp.constraint_density: Not an independent axis of the current complete-graph CVRP model. Solver neighborhood width is a configuration axis, not input constraint density.
cvrp.cross_variant_gap: Implemented integral-time VRPTW generation, PyVRP input mapping and independent time-window/fleet verification. Ordinary CVRP inputs retain their existing encoding.

split_requirements: Bind every instance by SHA-256, generator version/parameters, source/license and seed namespace.
No overlapping instance hashes, source groups or seed namespaces between calibration, development and evaluation.
Held-out distribution cells must include parameter levels or combinations absent from diverse development, not only different solver seeds.
Partition same-source instances and related generated variants together; do not scatter equivalent representations across train/test roles.
Use complete declared eligible public benchmark inventories with exclusion reasons and a systematic generated factor design; do not hand-pick successful instances.
Check observed size/density/coefficient/capacity descriptors against requested levels after materialization.
Different categorical shifts are not automatically ordered by severity. A severity coordinate or distance-to-reference requires an explicit pre-measurement definition.
Keep easy regression cases and difficult cases; baseline failure or nonzero gap alone does not establish attainable source-level improvement.
headroom_requirements: Before Agent runs, qualify at least one non-Agent-visible, semantically valid reference intervention under the SAME per-solve budget for each scored opportunity stratum.
Use disjoint calibration/qualification instances and fresh reversed-order confirmation; retain negative references and all excluded strata.
A stronger reference solution, a larger solve budget or a configuration change is not itself proof of a source-code optimization opportunity.
For exact solved coverage use independently established optimum targets; best_found references remain distinct and cannot certify optimality.

scenario_requirements.trajectory: Export timestamped improving assignments, verify every scored incumbent independently, retain uncovered time and censoring. Uncertified solver bounds stay diagnostic; a primal integral needs frozen loss/reference rules.
scenario_requirements.lifecycle: Use one worker and retained solver object across the declared solve sequence. Fix warmup, cleanup/reset, sampling and growth estimator before measurement; process peak RSS is not retained-memory growth.
scenario_requirements.scaling: Verify the source build and API support the declared thread/resource grid. Compare a shared quality target with wall/CPU/memory accounting. Independent multi-process portfolios are a separate experiment, not native thread scaling.
scenario_requirements.sequence: Replay identical model-update sequences in cold and warm modes with per-step independent quality targets. A fresh process or externally supplied incumbent does not establish in-place reoptimization.
scenario_requirements.numerical: Bind original-model witnesses and independently recompute original-unit feasibility, integrality, objectives and status contradictions. Routing integer-range/rounding checks are not floating-point MIP conditioning tests.
scenario_requirements.replay: Replay identical input/seed/thread/mode with declared comparison fields and tolerances; do not call different solver seeds identical-seed replay.

scoring_requirements: Retain existing native quality/coverage/PAR2 and resource estimators and task solve budgets; no composite radar score or post-hoc best metric.
Declare additional solve-budget levels, targets, tolerances, tradeoff limits and scenario reductions before their first measured run.
Report A/B/C per realized patch, per distribution cell and family; C-B is the mechanism intervention contrast.
With one Agent start, instance/solver-seed uncertainty does not estimate Agent-generation variance; do not claim population-level enhancement significance.
Freeze state-conditioned policies before the hidden test. Separately audit feature-off, always-on and conditional variants on evaluator-owned diagnostic cases.

capability_qualification.scope: Implementation qualification only; not formal generalization outcomes.
capability_qualification.native_mip_incremental: CBC retains an LP basis while resetting the MIP tree; SCIP uses native serial reoptimization.
capability_qualification.uncertified_bounds: Native reported bounds are retained as diagnostics; missing certificates keep dual integrals unavailable.

reference_calibration.scope: Evaluator reference interventions, not new experimental Agent attempts.
reference_calibration.cross_family_qualification: Set packing and covering now have valid measurements with mixed native classifications. Full headroom qualification, including reversed-order confirmation, remains pending.

extension.input_format: Standard MPS field widths. All original 2070 input hashes unchanged.
extension.failed_and_superseded_attempts: Retained with collection counts and distinct measurement identities; not used as positive performance evidence.

reference_calibration.headroom_qualification: Scored opportunity strata still require formal qualification; measurements do not by themselves make the study ready.
